name: frontend
description: Frontend engineering and review knowledge for Vue 3, Nuxt and Next.js, with one router skill that selects a framework's rules per workspace from its package.json and loads only that set: reactivity, composables, routing, client vs server state, build-time config and secrets, SSR state, data fetching and hydration. Framework-level only, and version-gated. Contains no facts about any individual repository.
